sentences.en: I hoped you could hurl some lumens into the gloom.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能把一些光子投进黑暗中。

sentences.en: With a deafening roar, the rocket was hurled into space.
sentences.zh: 伴随着震耳欲聋的轰鸣，火箭被猛掷向太空。

sentences.en: Without gravity we would be hurled off into space.
sentences.zh: 没有重力的作用，我们会被抛入太空。

senses.zh: 丢下；用力投掷；愤慨地说出
